symptom.verifier_failure: cargo build/check required src/bin/fantasy_restaurant.rs before its owner task could materialize it

dynamic_evidence.director_repair_behavior: Director attempted write/edit for the missing bin and was correctly denied by DEO scope authority

root_cause.summary: The completion compiler preferred an exact verifier authority hash even when that task did not own or depend on every artifact covered by the verifier.
root_cause.why_director_cannot_fix: TASK-1 capability correctly forbids writing TASK-2's entrypoint; retrying Director with the same contradictory contract cannot converge.

behavior: Require verifier owner dependency closure to contain every covered artifact owner.
Preserve exact committed argv/cwd while rebinding.
Choose the earliest unique dependency-complete owner.
Fail closed when covered owners are parallel or no unique dependency-complete owner exists.

residual_risk: Fresh provider output may expose another independent platform defect after this P0 is removed.
Live revalidation must prove TASK-1 no longer fails on TASK-2-owned entrypoint and that later owner executes the verifier.
